create_ConcatIndices: create a ConcatIndices helper to map indices of concatenated datasets to sample indices
build_CSVLogger: build a CSVLogger that buffers rows and flushes them to a file on demand
create_MonitoredDataset: create a MonitoredDataset wrapper that monitors per-worker resource usage and logs to CSV
build_NondeterministicDataLoader: build a NondeterministicDataLoader that returns batches out of order for multi-worker training
run_get_worker_info: run get_worker_info to retrieve the number of workers and current worker id from a DataLoader context
